en.name: Salsa, picante and taco sauce
en.summary: Jarred salsa, picante sauce and taco sauce are acidified, shelf-stable commercial products. Unopened they keep about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard. Once opened, the fridge gives about 1 month — and the label's advice to refrigerate is about quality rather than safety.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. Shelf-stable commercial salsa is safe when stored at room temperature after opening; quality, not safety, is the reason the labels suggest refrigerating it, and refrigeration simply ensures commercial sauces and condiments stay fresh for a longer period of time. A jar left warm will darken and lose its fresh bite long before anything else happens to it. Fresh refrigerated salsa from a chilled cabinet is a different product and was never a cupboard item.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep the jar at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 1 month. Spoon out what you need with a clean spoon into a separate bowl, and never put a chip or a spoon that has been in a bowl back into the jar — double-dipping is the fastest way to ruin a jar of salsa. Wipe the rim before closing so dried sauce does not crust into the thread.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for jarred salsa and it is not a good candidate. Tomatoes, onions and peppers are mostly water, and what thaws is a slack, watery sauce that has lost its texture — the pieces collapse and liquid separates out. Since an opened jar already has a month in the fridge, buy the size that matches how fast you get through it, and use the last of a jar in a cooked dish where texture matters less.
spoilage: Mould on the surface, around the rim or under the lid
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
Fizzing, bubbling or a lid that has domed up
Colour gone dark brown with liquid separated on top
tips: Never dip directly into the jar; spoon salsa into a serving bowl.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Keep jars out of sunlight, which darkens a tomato sauce quickly.
Buy small jars unless you are feeding a crowd — a month goes quickly.

faq.q: Does jarred salsa need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — a shelf-stable commercial salsa is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps it fresher for longer, which is why the label suggests it.

faq.q: How long does salsa last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1 month after opening at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of salsa keep?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard.
No timeline is given and it is a poor candidate — it thaws watery and slack. Buy the jar size you will finish instead.

zh.name: 市售莎莎醬與塔可醬
zh.summary: 瓶裝莎莎醬、picante 醬和塔可醬都是經過酸化、可常溫保存的市售產品。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後冷藏大約 1 個月——而標籤建議冷藏，講的是品質而不是安全。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 1 年。常溫販售的市售莎莎醬，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的；標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全，冷藏只是讓市售醬料維持新鮮更久。放在溫暖處的罐子會先變深、失去新鮮的酸勁，而不是先出現安全問題。冷藏櫃販售的生鮮莎莎醬則是不同產品，本來就不是櫥櫃食品。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 1 個月內用完。用乾淨的湯匙把要用的份量舀到另一個碗，而且絕對不要把沾過的玉米片或碗裡的湯匙再伸回罐子——重複沾取是毀掉一罐莎莎醬最快的方法。蓋回去前擦一下瓶口，避免醬垢卡進螺紋。
zh.freezer: 瓶裝莎莎醬沒有提供冷凍期限，而且並不適合。番茄、洋蔥和辣椒幾乎都是水，解凍後會變成鬆垮出水、失去口感的醬——料塊塌掉，水也分離出來。既然開封後冷藏已經有一個月，請依你消耗的速度選罐子大小，最後剩下的就用在熟食料理裡，那裡口感沒那麼關鍵。
spoilage: 醬面、瓶口或蓋子內側長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
顏色轉成深褐，表面分離出液體
tips: 不要直接沾罐子；請把莎莎醬舀到上桌的碗裡。
避免日曬，陽光會讓番茄醬類很快變深。
除非要招待一群人，否則買小罐——一個月過得很快。

faq.q: 瓶裝莎莎醬開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的市售莎莎醬開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了維持新鮮更久，所以標籤才會建議。

faq.q: 莎莎醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 1 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的莎莎醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。
沒有提供期限，也不適合——解凍後會出水鬆垮。建議改買吃得完的罐子大小。
